title: Preview: Chelsea v Leeds United, who has the edge?
body:
Chelsea host Leeds United in the Premier League on 2026-11-21 [F1]. The Touchline Takes Analyst model gives Chelsea a 33% chance of winning, the draw 40% and Leeds United 28% [M1]. In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Chelsea have 3 wins, 0 draws and 2 defeats from their last 5 league games: 9 points, 9 scored and 4 conceded [ST1].

In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Leeds United have 1 win, 2 draws and 2 defeats from their last 5 league games: 5 points, 3 scored and 5 conceded [ST2]. The last meeting in our Football-Data.co.uk results, on 2026-02-10, finished Chelsea 2-2 Leeds United [ST3]. The latest from BBC Sport: “Which game will Chelsea's Palmer miss after red card?” [S1].

This is the kind of fixture where one moment of quality settles everything. Expect nerves early and a lot more freedom once the first goal goes in. The Touchline Take: too close to call, and the draw is very much in play.
